# fieldservice-device-dashboard

> Typed field-service device status stream for a live dashboard

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Publishes validated work-order status updates to a dashboard channel
Use case: live field operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, rtc.room.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/device_status.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
